title: Code-Distance Falsifier
object_tested: BT1853 GF3 optical incidence compiler with 72 total symbols, 66 edge payload symbols, and 6 cyclic-distance parity symbols

six_row_code.verdict: check code only; not a standalone distance-bearing stabilizer code

with_face_rows.reason: two errors in the same cyclic-distance class can cancel the six-row check, so distance is not proven above 2 without adding independent face/vertex constraints on parity symbols

falsifier: The raw [72,66,6] incidence compiler detects some structured errors but does not by itself prove quantum code distance greater than 2.
surviving_candidate: A subsystem/stabilizer candidate remains possible only after adding face-row constraints, antipodal-sheet constraints, and a logical/gauge split; this is a future code construction, not BT1853 itself.
boundary: Finite linear-code falsifier over GF3; it does not analyze a full CSS/subsystem quantum code.
